metadata.title: Terrascope AI — Disaster Structural Damage & Debris Assessment
metadata.coordinate_system: Local Metric Cartesian (Origin at Scene Center)

assumptions_and_limitations: Height estimates are derived from monocular aerial/satellite neural regression above local datum.
Debris expansion coefficient assumes mixed masonry/concrete rubble (K=1.30 ± 0.15).
Monocular RGB imagery cannot penetrate dense dust clouds or measure hidden subterranean foundation voids.
Ground truth validation requires post-event LiDAR or stereoscopic photogrammetric DSM.
